question.problem:
Consider the absolute value equation 

$$
5-|x-3|=-3.
$$

This equation can be expressed in the following equivalent form:

$$
|x-3|=k
$$

What is the value of $k?$
question.worked_solution:
We can rearrange the equation to isolate the absolute value on the left side:

First, we subtract $5$ from both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}5-|x-3|=-3 \\ 5-|x-3|-5=-3-5 \\ -|x-3|=-8\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we multiply both sides of the equation by $-1:$

$$
\begin{aligned}-|x-3| & =-8 \\ (-1)\cdot (-|x-3|) & =(-1)\cdot (-8) \\ (\cancel{-}1)\cdot (\cancel{-}|x-3|) & =8 \\ |x-3| & =8\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $k=8.$
